meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后 NanoClaw 会把 Emacs 接成一个聊天频道:可在 Emacs 内打开聊天 buffer 提问,也可把 org 标题或选中区域发出去,回复以子标题形式写回 org 文件。走本地 HTTP 桥,无需 bot token。
howto.when: 在 Emacs 里按快捷键打开聊天 buffer(如 C-c n c),或用 nanoclaw-org-send 发送当前 org 子标题、选中区域等时触发。仅在 .env 设 EMACS_ENABLED=true 并重启 NanoClaw 后生效。

say.text: 把 nanoclaw.el 加载到我的 Emacs 配置里,并绑好聊天快捷键
把当前这个 org 标题发给 NanoClaw,整理成行动项清单
say.note: 回复会作为子标题写回 org

say.text: NanoClaw 在 Emacs 里没反应,帮我排查一下
say.note: 检查端口、环境变量和频道注册

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw adds Emacs as a chat channel: open a chat buffer inside Emacs to ask questions, or send an org heading or region and the reply lands as a child heading. Local HTTP bridge, no bot token.
howto.when_en: It takes over once you press your chat-buffer keybinding (e.g. C-c n c) in Emacs, or call nanoclaw-org-send on the current org heading or region. Requires EMACS_ENABLED=true and a restart.

say_en.text: Load nanoclaw.el into my Emacs config and bind the chat keybinding
Send this org heading to NanoClaw and turn it into an action list
say_en.note: Reply arrives as a child heading

say_en.text: NanoClaw isn't answering in Emacs - help me debug it
say_en.note: Checks port, env flag and wiring
